**What problem are you trying to solve?**
Describe the situation, not only the solution you have in mind (e.g. "my PC froze and I found out only two days later").

**What would you like to happen?**
A clear description of what you would like Always on Mint to do.

**Alternatives you have considered**
Other ways you tried or thought about.

**Your setup**
Distribution and version (e.g. Linux Mint 22.1 Xfce), laptop or desktop, what the PC runs (bots, servers...).
